rules: Each claim and opposing argument requires a direct original paragraph and accurate source role; a secondary quotation of Fletcher is not the original book.
A source-supported inference is not a verbatim author's position. Clinical guidelines do not pronounce moral doctrine.
English and French wording must independently preserve the same limited claim; live canonical ownership must remain unchanged.
Only after all eight stages have original-passage support, documented exact opponent attribution where relevant, and detailed French proof-reading may full certification be considered.
Any named theological certification requires an independent competent human theological editor; this file does not claim imprimatur.

stages.explanation_en: Fletcher's agape position is corroborated through reproduced excerpts, not independent full-book collation.
stages.explanation_fr: Fletcher: agapè confirmée par des extraits reproduits, non par la collation autonome du livre intégral.

stages.explanation_en: Good intention influences moral analysis; 'same outward act' needs object-level qualification.
stages.explanation_fr: L'intention compte, mais « même acte extérieur » exige une précision sur l'objet moral.

stages.explanation_en: Veritatis Splendor §78 expressly distinguishes object and intention.
stages.explanation_fr: Veritatis Splendor §78 distingue expressément objet et intention.

stages.explanation_en: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 rejects a good end as sufficient to justify every means.
stages.explanation_fr: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 rejette la suffisance d'une fin bonne pour justifier tout moyen.

stages.explanation_en: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 directly supports object, intention and circumstances.
stages.explanation_fr: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 fonde la distinction objet, intention et circonstances.

stages.explanation_en: The objection is an authored analytical challenge, not Fletcher's quoted reply.
stages.explanation_fr: Cette objection analytique est rédigée, non citée de Fletcher.

stages.explanation_en: Reasoned application of object/intention distinction rather than a literal source passage.
stages.explanation_fr: Application raisonnée de la distinction objet/intention, non citation littérale.

stages.explanation_en: Veritatis Splendor §78 explicitly affirms a good end alone is insufficient.
stages.explanation_fr: Veritatis Splendor §78 affirme qu'une bonne fin ne suffit pas.

stages.explanation_en: Fletcher's exceptionless agape norm is documented through attributed excerpts; original volume still uncollated.
stages.explanation_fr: La norme d'agapè de Fletcher est connue par extraits attribués ; ouvrage intégral non collationné.

stages.explanation_en: Valid attention to circumstances; not a specific verbatim Fletcher claim.
stages.explanation_fr: Attention légitime aux circonstances, sans citation directe de Fletcher.

stages.explanation_en: Veritatis Splendor distinguishes moral object from personal blame and circumstances.
stages.explanation_fr: Veritatis Splendor distingue l'objet moral de la culpabilité personnelle et des circonstances.

stages.explanation_en: Veritatis Splendor §§79–80 rejects situational justification of intrinsic evils.
stages.explanation_fr: Veritatis Splendor §§79–80 exclut la justification situationnelle des actes intrinsèquement mauvais.

stages.explanation_en: Intrinsic evil depends on object, not identical blame in all actors.
stages.explanation_fr: Le mal intrinsèque dépend de l'objet, non d'une culpabilité identique de tous.

stages.explanation_en: An author-created question, not an actual Fletcher quotation.
stages.explanation_fr: Question de débat reconstruite, non citation de Fletcher.

stages.explanation_en: Analytical reply based on Veritatis Splendor; identifying the moral object requires further reasoning.
stages.explanation_fr: Réponse analysée sur Veritatis Splendor ; définir l'objet demande un raisonnement supplémentaire.

stages.explanation_en: Valid synthesis of objective norm and subjective culpability.
stages.explanation_fr: Synthèse valide des normes objectives et de la culpabilité subjective.

stages.explanation_en: Modern reconstructed challenge about marital debt; not a direct quoted traditional authority.
stages.explanation_fr: Objection reconstruite sur le devoir conjugal, non citation d'une autorité précise.

stages.explanation_en: Historic mutual marital obligations need exact primary manual/canon passage collation.
stages.explanation_fr: Les obligations conjugales réciproques requièrent une collation précise des textes anciens.

stages.explanation_en: Proportional reasons for refusing relations are not established by Humanae Vitae §13 alone.
stages.explanation_fr: Les raisons proportionnées de refus ne sont pas établies par Humanae Vitae §13 seule.

stages.explanation_en: Humanae Vitae §13 explicitly excludes imposed intercourse against reasonable wishes.
stages.explanation_fr: Humanae Vitae §13 exclut expressément l'union imposée sans égard aux souhaits raisonnables.

stages.explanation_en: Humanae Vitae §13 says imposed intercourse disregarding spouse's condition is not true love.
stages.explanation_fr: Humanae Vitae §13 exclut l'acte imposé sans considération de l'état du conjoint.

stages.explanation_en: Question constructed for debate, not a quoted interlocutor.
stages.explanation_fr: Question illustrative, non citation d'un interlocuteur.

stages.explanation_en: No coercive entitlement follows from the distinction between moral obligations and force.
stages.explanation_fr: Aucun droit de contrainte ne découle de la distinction entre devoir moral et force.

stages.explanation_en: Humanae Vitae §13 affirms no legitimate entitlement to an imposed act.
stages.explanation_fr: Humanae Vitae §13 refuse toute légitimation d'un acte imposé.

stages.explanation_en: Illustrative reluctant spouse dilemma; no specific identified opponent's verbatim testimony.
stages.explanation_fr: Dilemme illustratif du conjoint réticent, non témoignage attribué.

stages.explanation_en: Relevant difficult circumstances explicitly assumed in Casti Connubii §59.
stages.explanation_fr: Le cas difficile est envisagé par Casti Connubii §59.

stages.explanation_en: Casti Connubii §59 distinguishes the reluctant spouse from the one committing wrong.
stages.explanation_fr: Casti Connubii §59 distingue le conjoint réticent de celui qui choisit le mal.

stages.explanation_en: Casti Connubii §59 supports distinct responsibility but only under stated conditions.
stages.explanation_fr: Casti Connubii §59 fonde la distinction sous conditions expresses.

stages.explanation_en: Grave cause, reluctant allowance and duty to dissuade are explicit in §59.
stages.explanation_fr: Raison grave, tolérance à contrecœur et devoir de dissuader figurent en §59.

stages.explanation_en: A constructed 'loophole' objection, not a cited proponent.
stages.explanation_fr: Objection illustrative de la « brèche », non thèse citée.

stages.explanation_en: The same §59 does not license contraception, only differentiates the other spouse's responsibility.
stages.explanation_fr: Le §59 distingue la responsabilité et ne rend pas la contraception licite.

stages.explanation_en: Casti Connubii §59 expressly requires charity and discouraging wrongdoing.
stages.explanation_fr: Casti Connubii §59 exige expressément la charité et la dissuasion.

stages.explanation_en: Persona Humana §9 identifies contemporary claims about masturbation, while Farley's own page-referenced view is quoted in CDF 2012.
stages.explanation_fr: Persona Humana §9 présente les objections modernes ; la position de Farley est reproduite avec pages par la CDF en 2012.

stages.explanation_en: It lacks coercion/adultery as additional acts; not equal to doctrinal innocence.
stages.explanation_fr: Absence de contrainte ou d'adultère n'implique pas innocence morale.

stages.explanation_en: Persona Humana §9 specifically discusses immaturity, psychological imbalance and habit affecting culpability.
stages.explanation_fr: Persona Humana §9 décrit immaturité, déséquilibre psychologique et habitude dans la culpabilité.

stages.explanation_en: Persona Humana §9 states the moral rationale beyond harm to another person.
stages.explanation_fr: Persona Humana §9 donne un fondement moral distinct du dommage à autrui.

stages.explanation_en: Persona Humana §9 directly describes the chosen act and its moral category.
stages.explanation_fr: Persona Humana §9 décrit l'acte volontaire et sa qualification morale.

stages.explanation_en: The nutrition analogy is editorial, not a quotation from Farley.
stages.explanation_fr: L'analogie alimentaire est illustrative, non attribuée à Farley.

stages.explanation_en: Argument by the human ends of the sexual faculty; not a direct comparative claim in §9.
stages.explanation_fr: Raisonnement sur la fin de la faculté sexuelle ; comparaison non littérale du §9.

stages.explanation_en: Persona Humana §9 expressly avoids presuming absence of grave responsibility.
stages.explanation_fr: Persona Humana §9 exclut de présumer l'absence de responsabilité grave.

stages.explanation_en: A sympathetic IVF proposal is reconstructed from ART practice rather than quoted as an author's philosophical defense.
stages.explanation_fr: La défense de la FIV est reconstruite depuis les pratiques d'AMP, non citée comme argument personnel.

stages.explanation_en: Dignitas Personae §13 recognizes infertile couples' pain and legitimate desire for children.
stages.explanation_fr: Dignitas Personae §13 reconnaît la souffrance de l'infertilité et le désir légitime d'enfant.

stages.explanation_en: Dignitas Personae §§12–13 expressly permits assistance restoring natural fertility.
stages.explanation_fr: Dignitas Personae §§12–13 permet explicitement les traitements restaurant la fertilité.

stages.explanation_en: Dignitas Personae §12 identifies replacement versus assistance to conjugal act.
stages.explanation_fr: Dignitas Personae §12 distingue remplacement et aide à l'acte conjugal.

stages.explanation_en: Dignitas Personae §§12–17 and Donum Vitae distinguish morally illicit IVF from lawful assistance; updated wording avoids 'merely problematic'.
stages.explanation_fr: Dignitas Personae §§12–17 et Donum Vitae excluent la FIV de substitution ; rédaction corrigée.

stages.explanation_en: A hypothetical couple's objection, not a verbatim ASRM/clinical statement.
stages.explanation_fr: Objection hypothétique du couple, non parole citée de l'ASRM.

stages.explanation_en: Dignitas Personae §16 directly grounds dignity of procreation in bodily self-giving.
stages.explanation_fr: Dignitas Personae §16 fonde la procréation dans le don corporel des époux.

stages.explanation_en: Dignitas Personae §§12–18 describes substitution and additional embryo harms.
stages.explanation_fr: Dignitas Personae §§12–18 traite de substitution et des dommages aux embryons.

stages.explanation_en: ASRM ethics opinion 2023 explicitly accepts gestational-carrier arrangements under safeguards; this is paraphrase, not verbatim quote.
stages.explanation_fr: ASRM 2023 admet la GPA sous conditions ; objection reformulée, non citation verbatim.

stages.explanation_en: ASRM acknowledges economic, familial pressure and control conflicts; modified to avoid equating no payment with no exploitation.
stages.explanation_fr: ASRM évoque pressions économiques/familiales et conflits médicaux ; formulation corrigée.

stages.explanation_en: An altruistic motive can be sincere without resolving every structural moral issue.
stages.explanation_fr: Un motif généreux peut être sincère sans trancher les difficultés structurelles.

stages.explanation_en: Donum Vitae II.A.3 explicitly discusses separating gestation/parenthood.
stages.explanation_fr: Donum Vitae II.A.3 vise la séparation entre gestation et parentalité.

stages.explanation_en: Donum Vitae II.A.3 directly rejects surrogate motherhood, including noncommercial cases.
stages.explanation_fr: Donum Vitae II.A.3 exclut la maternité de substitution, même non commerciale.

stages.explanation_en: Adoption analogy is authored for debate, not an ASRM verbatim response.
stages.explanation_fr: Comparaison avec l'adoption construite, non réplique littérale d'ASRM.

stages.explanation_en: Differentiates prior deprivation remedied through adoption from deliberately arranged separation.
stages.explanation_fr: Distingue la réparation d'une privation de la séparation organisée.

stages.explanation_en: Donum Vitae II.A.3 grounds objections in the rights of child and obligations of parenthood.
stages.explanation_fr: Donum Vitae II.A.3 fonde la critique sur les droits de l'enfant et la parentalité.

stages.explanation_en: Emergency dilemma is reconstructed, not an attributed ACOG ethical statement.
stages.explanation_fr: Dilemme d'urgence reconstruit, non position morale attribuée à l'ACOG.

stages.explanation_en: ACOG clinical original supports emergency danger and need for intervention, not a moral preference.
stages.explanation_fr: ACOG confirme l'urgence clinique, sans trancher la préférence morale.

stages.explanation_en: ACOG describes ruptured ectopic pregnancy and need for urgent care.
stages.explanation_fr: ACOG décrit la rupture et la nécessité de soins urgents.

stages.explanation_en: CDF 2009 differentiates direct abortion and therapeutic intervention as distinct moral objects.
stages.explanation_fr: La CDF 2009 distingue l'avortement direct du traitement thérapeutique.

stages.explanation_en: CDF principle is magisterial; salpingectomy / methotrexate / salpingostomy classification remains non-magisterial and debated.
stages.explanation_fr: Principe magistériel clair ; application aux techniques précises discutée entre moralistes.

stages.explanation_en: Wordplay objection is illustrative, not directly published by ACOG.
stages.explanation_fr: Objection de « jeu de mots » illustrative, non énoncée par ACOG.

stages.explanation_en: Double effect distinction applied; disputed individual procedures need further text.
stages.explanation_fr: Application du principe à vérifier selon la technique spécifique.

stages.explanation_en: CDF 2009 affirms direct-abortion ban and distinguishes certain medical treatments.
stages.explanation_fr: La CDF 2009 exclut l'avortement direct et distingue certains traitements.
